title: Bacon-Wrapped Pork Tenderloin
description: Two tenderloins wrapped in maple bacon and glazed with maple syrup, roasted hot so the bacon crisps while the pork stays juicy.

steps.heading: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven to 450°F. Line a large rimmed baking pan with foil.

steps.heading: Wrap
steps.text: Place the tenderloins on the pan and sprinkle with the salt and pepper. Starting at one end, wrap each tenderloin with 4 slices of bacon, stretching the bacon slightly so it thins out to cover the pork. Drizzle the maple syrup over the top and space the tenderloins 2 to 3 inches apart.

steps.heading: Roast
steps.text: Roast for 20 to 25 minutes, turning once halfway, until the bacon browns and the pork reaches 145°F inside. Move to a cutting board and let stand 5 minutes before slicing.
